title: In-person classes suspended anew in Cebu due to haze

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — In-person classes have been suspended for Monday, Sept. 21, in several areas in Cebu as transboundary haze from ongoing forest fires in Indonesia worsened air quality on Sunday, Sept. 20. Cebu City was the latest local government to announce the suspension. Mayor Nestor Archival suspended face-to-face classes at all levels in public and private schools after air quality remained at acutely unhealthy levels Sunday afternoon.
